# Where to find and turn in Pleasant Valley Claim Tickets

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Sep 5, 2021
- 2 min read

Updated: Jul 29, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_26c849013676416aa213b08dcee2dc43~mv2.jpg)

**Scroll down to the bottom of this guide for the interactive checklist.**

Pleasant Valley Claim Tickets can be found on Ghouls or Scorched once your character has completed the questline "__Key to the Past__", given by Rose at the Top of the World.

Claim tickets are tradable and can be purchased from Player Vendors or traded in bulk.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_aaaff5478dcf449ba8473f1d59022426~mv2.jpg)

They can be turned into the Bellhop, downstairs, at the Pleasant Valley Ski Resort.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0bed38824ac444ecbd82aaea1ff4e252~mv2.jpg)
